com.apple.developer.secure-element-crede.title: com.apple.developer.secure-element-credential.default-contactless-app

com.apple.developer.security.privileged-.title: Privileged File Operations

com.apple.developer.spatial-audio.profil.title: com.apple.developer.spatial-audio.profile-access

com.apple.developer.storekit.external-pu.title: com.apple.developer.storekit.external-purchase-link-streaming

com.apple.developer.sustained-execution.title: com.apple.developer.sustained-execution
